records.caption:
Your vanity deserves a little Hollywood glow.

Bad bathroom light hides uneven foundation until you step outside. This LED vanity mirror lets you switch between warm, neutral and cool light and dim it smoothly, so you can see your skin and makeup clearly and finish your look with confidence.

• 3 light colors (warm, neutral, cool) with smooth touch dimming
• Rechargeable 2400 mAh battery, no cord needed while you use it
• Stands on your desk or dresser, with a small tray for makeup

Link in the first comment. ¥6,980.
